ValidationRule.description: Names must be trimmed, free of double spaces, not start with a digit (ASCII 48-57), and approved names must be in title case.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( Name <> TRIM(Name), FIND(' ', Name) > 0, AND(ASCII(LEFT(Name, 1)) >= 48, ASCII(LEFT(Name, 1)) <= 57), AND(Is_Approved__c, Name <> INITCAP(LOWER(Name))), LEN(Name) > 80 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Project name fails hygiene checks (spacing, leading digit, casing, or length).
